{{Quote|It's too dangerous. The mercenaries are targeting us. It's up to you, Bravo Flight.|Ric Olié just after the mercenaries appeared|<ref name="SWSF" />}}
Shortly before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Blockade of Naboo]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] '''attempted to kidnap''' [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Queen Amidala]], leader of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]]. The mercenaries were secretly hired by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. The Federation lured the Queen of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] out to a remote region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] on the pretense of conducting negotiations. When the royal delegation reached the location, they were attacked by mercenaries. Unable to safely jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], the [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|royal starship]] hid in an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field as [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Essara Till/Legends|Essara Till]] and [[Rhys Dallows]] fended off waves of mercenary [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Eventually, Queen Amidala escaped to hyperspace, but not the Bravo pilots.

==The attempt==
{{Quote|Unidentified craft, power down or you will be fired upon.|Till to the mercenaries|<ref name="SWSF" />}}
Some time before the Invasion of Naboo, Queen Amidala agreed with the Trade Federation to meet for negotiations in a remote region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. As the [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|Royal starship]] approached the Federation [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|ship]], [[Dagger-class starfighter|three]] [[MorningStar|mercenary]] [[Dianoga-class assault starfighter|ships]] approached quickly. The Trade Federation battleship immediately left for [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], but the Naboo delegation was not as fast. [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo]] pilots [[Essara Till/Legends|Essara Till]] and [[Rhys Dallows]] were sent to defend the Royal [[Starship/Legends|starship]] until it was ready for hyperspace. Till ordered Dallows to concentrate on the Daggers. After the first three starfighters, the mercenaries attacked in waves of Daggers, followed by waves of MorningStars. During the fighting, the Queen's starship took cover in a nearby [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] belt.<ref name="SF2" />

Just as the Royal starship was ready to make the jump to hyperspace, a wing of Dianogas came through the asteroids blocking the ship's escape route. Dallows attacked the new starfighters, enabling the Royal starship to finally escape. After the Queen's escape, a MorningStar came up behind and fired upon Dallows. Till came around to shoot the MorningStar. At that point, the [[Unidentified mercenary leader|leader of the mercenaries]] chose to appear. He shot down Till and disabled Dallows in quick succession using his [[Unidentified mercenary craft|craft's]] [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] before leaving.<ref name="SF2" />

==Aftermath==
Rhys Dallows was later found by the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Reti]] as he was scavenging for parts. Together, the two found Essara's body in the remains of her [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].<ref name="SFPC" /> Dallows and Reti would later join forces with the mercenary [[Vana Sage]] and the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] to fight the Trade Federation.<ref name="SWSF" />

==Behind the scenes==
This article was created based on "The Royal Escort," the second mission in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]. [[Star Wars: Starfighter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|The game's strategy guide]] outlines the mission objectives.
